Hurricane Isaias Tropical Cyclone Update
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL       AL092026
1030 PM CDT Wed Oct 07 2026

...ISAIAS BECOMES A HURRICANE...

Dropsonde data from an Air Force Reserve hurricane hunter aircraft 
indicates that Isaias has become a hurricane, with maximum sustained 
winds of 75 mph (120 km/h) with higher gusts. The minimum central 
pressure measured from another dropsonde launched in the eye was  
982 mb (29.00 inches). 
 
SUMMARY OF 1030 PM CDT...0330 UTC...INFORMATION
---------------------------------------------------
LOCATION...22.9N 91.9W
ABOUT 180 MI...290 KM NW OF PROGRESO MEXICO
ABOUT 460 MI...745 KM SSW OF THE MOUTH OF THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER
MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...75 MPH...120 KM/H
PRESENT MOVEMENT...ENE OR 70 DEGREES AT 9 MPH...15 KM/H
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE...982 MB...29.00 INCHES
